items.exampleEn: The trainer blew his whistle and the players ran back to the line.
items.exampleZh: 教練吹了哨子，球員們跑回線上。

items.exampleEn: He keeps his skateboard under his desk at the office.
items.exampleZh: 他把滑板放在辦公室的桌子底下。

items.exampleEn: In chess, you should always think about your opponent's next move.
items.exampleZh: 下西洋棋時，要隨時想著對手的下一步。

items.exampleEn: Even when they were losing, the team never lost its fighting spirit.
items.exampleZh: 即使落後，那支隊伍也從未失去鬥志。

items.exampleEn: The small town found fame after a popular film was shot there.
items.exampleZh: 一部熱門電影在那裡拍攝後，那個小鎮就出名了。

items.exampleEn: The national squad flew home after the tournament.
items.exampleZh: 國家隊在錦標賽結束後搭機返國。

items.exampleEn: There is a glass case full of trophies in the school hall.
items.exampleZh: 學校大廳有一個裝滿獎盃的玻璃櫃。

items.exampleEn: The company offers free coaching to help staff speak in public.
items.exampleZh: 公司提供免費指導，幫助員工練習公開演說。

items.exampleEn: More than ten thousand runners took part in the city marathon.
items.exampleZh: 一萬多名跑者參加了城市馬拉松。
items.glossZh: 馬拉松；（比喻）漫長費力的事

items.sentenceEn: She trained for six months before running her first marathon.
items.sentenceZh: 她訓練了六個月，才跑了第一場馬拉松。

items.audioEn: Our squad meets at the field at seven, so please don't be late for the bus.
items.audioZh: 我們隊七點在球場集合，請別錯過巴士。

items.sentenceEn: With better coaching, our team has improved a lot this season.
items.sentenceZh: 有了更好的訓練指導，我們隊這一季進步了很多。

items.sentenceEn: The kids practiced tricks on their skateboards in the park.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們在公園裡用滑板練習花式動作。

items.stemEn: Our team captain lifted the ____ above her head as the crowd cheered.
items.stemZh: 隊長在觀眾的歡呼聲中把獎盃高舉過頭。

items.stemEn: Before the game, he watched videos of his ____ to learn how she plays.
items.stemZh: 比賽前，他看了對手的影片，研究她怎麼打。

items.passageEn: When Mia joined the school basketball squad, she was the shortest player on the team. Her trainer, a legendary former player, saw her fighting spirit and gave her extra coaching after school. Mia practiced every day, even on weekends, and she also ran long distances to get fitter. In the final game of the season, her team faced its strongest opponent. Mia scored the winning basket in the last second, and the team won its first trophy in ten years. The local newspaper wrote about her, and she enjoyed a little fame. Next year, she plans to run a marathon with her trainer.
items.passageZh: 米亞加入學校籃球隊時，是隊上最矮的球員。她的教練是傳奇的前球員，看出她的鬥志，放學後給她額外的指導。米亞每天練習，連週末也不例外，還跑長距離鍛鍊體能。賽季最後一場比賽，她的隊伍遇上最強的對手。米亞在最後一秒投進致勝一球，球隊贏得十年來的第一座獎盃。當地報紙報導了她，她也小小出名了一下。明年，她打算和教練一起跑馬拉松。

questions.questionZh: 教練為什麼給米亞額外指導？

items.promptZh: 成名並沒有改變她對朋友的態度。
referenceEn: Fame did not change the way she treats her friends.
Her fame has not changed her attitude toward her friends.
rubricZh: fame 是不可數名詞，可當主詞（例如 Fame did not change…）
時態合理即可（例如 did not change、has not changed）

items.instructionZh: 用 skateboard 造一個句子，說說你或你認識的人玩滑板的經驗。
referenceEn: I tried to ride a skateboard once, but I fell after two seconds.
My cousin rides his skateboard to school every morning.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 skateboard（例如 ride a skateboard）
時態合理即可（例如 rides、tried）
